name: query-expr-with-query-construct-type-test-397e030880/query-expr-with-query-construct-type-update-key-1-p.bal
spec_references: Expressions > Query expressions: Supports `list` and `map` as `query-constructor-type`
reason: The invoked test constructs a keyed table using `table key(id, name) from ... select ...`, retrieves its row by composite key, and expects assigning even the same value to the table's readonly key field to panic. Table query construction is outside the specified list/map query-constructor support, so the essential setup and asserted key-immutability behavior are not wholly supported.
unsupported_constructs: Table query constructor `table key(id, name) from var user in users ... select ...`
test_design_notes: main invokes testQueryConstructingTableUpdateKeyPanic1; its `r2.id = 1` assignment is marked @panic.
